Nodes.Text: Warm hearth, dry beds, and no questions about the mud on your boots. A room is ten drams — best sleep in the village, and the world keeps turning while you get it.

Choices.Text: [10 drams] Take a room and rest.
What do you hear around the hearth?

Nodes.Text: Travelers talk. They say the far ring of the world has grown teeth lately — and that the old veins under the caves still carry quartz, salt, and darker ore, if you bring a strong arm and a sack. The scribes buy what the tinkers don't.
